description: Test suite for Mattermost server API endpoints related to system health, audits, email, support packets, site URL testing, database recycling, cache invalidation, logs, logs download, push notifications, onboarding, schema migrations, and server status, implemented as Go test functions.

methods.name: TestGetPing
methods.description: Tests the /system/ping endpoint for healthy and unhealthy statuses, including feature flags and root status.

methods.name: TestGetAudits
methods.description: Tests retrieval of audit logs with various parameters and permissions.

methods.name: TestEmailTest
methods.description: Tests email configuration and sending capabilities under different user permissions and settings.

methods.name: TestGenerateSupportPacket
methods.description: Tests support packet generation functionality for authorized users.

methods.name: TestSupportPacketFileName
methods.description: Validates support packet filename generation with different customer names and timestamps.

methods.name: TestSiteURLTest
methods.description: Tests the site URL validation endpoint for various URLs and user roles.

methods.name: TestDatabaseRecycle
methods.description: Tests the database recycle endpoint with different user permissions.

methods.name: TestInvalidateCaches
methods.description: Tests cache invalidation endpoint for permission enforcement.

methods.name: TestGetLogs
methods.description: Tests retrieval of server logs with different parameters and permissions.

methods.name: TestDownloadLogs
methods.description: Tests downloading of server logs as an admin and permission restrictions.

methods.name: TestPostLog
methods.description: Tests posting logs with developer mode enabled/disabled and permission restrictions.

methods.name: TestGetAnalyticsOld
methods.description: Tests retrieval of old analytics data, websocket connection counts, and permission enforcement.

methods.name: TestS3TestConnection
methods.description: Tests S3 connection with various configurations and permissions.

methods.name: TestSupportedTimezones
methods.description: Verifies supported timezones list matches configuration.

methods.name: TestRedirectLocation
methods.description: Tests URL redirection resolution, caching, and length restrictions.

methods.name: TestSetServerBusy
methods.description: Tests setting server busy status with permission checks.

methods.name: TestSetServerBusyInvalidParam
methods.description: Tests invalid parameters for setting server busy status.

methods.name: TestClearServerBusy
methods.description: Tests clearing server busy status with permission checks.

methods.name: TestGetServerBusy
methods.description: Tests retrieving server busy status with permission enforcement.

methods.name: TestServerBusy503
methods.description: Tests server behavior (503) when busy during user, team, and channel searches.

methods.name: TestPushNotificationAck
methods.description: Tests acknowledgment of push notifications, session property updates, and permission checks.

methods.name: TestCompleteOnboarding
methods.description: Tests onboarding completion, plugin installation, and cleanup for different user roles.

methods.name: TestGetAppliedSchemaMigrations
methods.description: Tests retrieval of applied schema migrations with permission checks.

methods.name: checkHasNilFields
methods.description: Utility to check if a struct has nil fields.
